_comment: Scenario: UC-03-01 daytime bayshore traffic-jam monotony drive.
Derived from uc02_monotony_v0_1; tuned to fire the monotony_prevention band of
nri_fatigue_score_v1 on the 6.9 km Funabashi-Makuhari route.
Design (combined_contracts task-5-round3, Option A):
- trigger: nri_fatigue_score_v1 (NOT the hybrid trigger).
- traffic_jam_kph: 8 kph so 6.9 km crawls for ~52 min (~17.3 ticks); the run
completes at tick 18 (~54 min); the UC brief: normally 20 min → ~50 min in jam.
- Persona '買い物後で軽い疲労あり' (light post-shopping fatigue) plus '渋滞でイライラ'
(jam-borne irritation) are modelled as: initial_state.fatigue_level=55 and a
raised fatigue_model.traffic_jam_add_per_min=0.10 (was 0.02).
- NRI score accumulation in full-route jam (familiar_route=true, is_night=false):
dS/dt = S_base(0.5*1.2=0.6/min) + S_jam(0.8/min) + S_mono(0.3/min)
= 1.7 pts/min = 5.1 pts per 3-min tick
threshold_monotony=60 crossed at ~tick 12 (~36 min).
- Route completes at tick 18 (~54 min): run-wide peak S_total ~= 90 pts, safely
in [60,100). Fire stays in monotony_prevention band; NEVER escalates to
rest_required (verified via /api/merged-runs/quickview: no rest fire; peak ~90).
- S_realtime = max(0, drowsiness-60)*1.5 + max(0, fatigue-60)*1.5.
initial_fatigue 55 grows to ~62 near completion, so fatigue contributes only a
LIGHT late accelerant (~4% of the score at the fire); monotony+jam remain the
deciding input (~96%). This preserves the 'monotony not fatigue' story while
honouring the persona's light post-shopping fatigue.
- drowsiness stays <60 the whole run -> zero drowsiness contribution.
- Scenario presets carry the jam event (start_min:0, duration:200 min)
so no jam_range_km override is needed from the test case.
- monotony_add_per_min kept at uc02 baseline (0.05): only affects the
drowsiness SIGNAL level, which stays <60 regardless.
